recommendation: Keep this source fix. Future work on ShareableCodeSystem profile constraints should remain in CRMI per FHIR-37959, but the base CodeSystem invariant belongs in core and now matches the FHIR-31753 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-31753 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab change request for R5. It asked to remove the ShareableCodeSystem profile requirement that CodeSystem.concept be present for every shareable code system, while adding a base CodeSystem invariant requiring at least one concept when CodeSystem.content is example, fragment, or complete.
initial_application: PR #2068 was implemented by commit 93fadfaa, which removed the old CodeSystem.concept min=1 constraint from source/codesystem/structuredefinition-profile-shareablecodesystem.xml and added an scs-2 invariant to that profile. The same commit did not modify source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml, so the approved base CodeSystem invariant was not present in current source.
additional_context: The May 2022 Vocab WGM minutes confirm the intended distinction: not-present code systems cannot have concepts, supplements may identify property types, and example, fragment, and complete code systems are expected to have concepts. Later FHIR-37959 removed ShareableCodeSystem and related terminology-resource profiles from core and moved ongoing profile maintenance to CRMI, but that profile migration does not supersede the base CodeSystem rule requested by FHIR-31753.
reconciliation: Added csd-9 to source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml with the expression `content in ( 'example' | 'fragment' | 'complete' ) implies concept.exists()`, and attached the condition to CodeSystem.content and CodeSystem.concept.
source_changes: source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml: added root constraint csd-9 for example/fragment/complete content requiring concept.exists().
source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml: marked CodeSystem.content and CodeSystem.concept with condition csd-9 so the invariant is visible on affected elements.

related_jiras.note: Approved and applied in the same May 2022 Vocab/PR #2068 ShareableCodeSystem profile work; its own constraints were already audited separately.

Later no-change issue about ShareableCodeSystem validation failures in R4B confirms related profile validation concerns but does not alter the base CodeSystem invariant.
